items.what: Name, email, phone, the chat conversation (up to the last 30 messages), the page the chat was on, what kind of message it is, and the notice the chat showed at the start
items.where: This website's database, as private Chat question posts
items.kept: 90 days, then a daily job deletes it. The Chat screen can set 30, 60, 180 or 365 days, or keep conversations only with a written reason. Deleting the plugin deletes them all. The site's privacy tools export and delete a person's conversations by the email they gave; one left with only a phone number is deleted by hand.
items.shared: Emailed to the address set on the Chat screen (the site admin email by default), plus a short text alert to the alert address if one is set
items.when: only when the visitor leaves their name and a phone number or email in the chat. On a law firm's site the chat asks for a name and phone number only, and keeps a short description (up to 500 characters) and the page address without its query string; it keeps no email and no conversation.

items.what: Questions typed in the chat, the earlier messages in the chat (up to 30), the page address and the website address
items.where: Sent from this website to the AI server. This website does not store them unless the visitor later leaves contact details.
items.shared: The AI server set on the Chat screen
items.when: only when an AI server is connected. On a law firm's site, only after the web team turns AI answers on.

items.what: A scrambled (hashed) copy of the visitor's IP address with a count, used to limit how many messages one visitor can send
items.where: A temporary record in this website's database
items.kept: 10 minutes after the visitor's last chat message

items.what: Chat opens, button taps and sent messages (the button words or message type, never names or messages)
items.where: Passed to Optima Analytics on the page
items.when: only when Optima Analytics is on

cookies.name: optimaChat (browser storage)
cookies.why: Keeps the chat so far (up to 40 messages) so it stays in place when the visitor moves to another page
cookies.lasts: Until the browser tab is closed

cookies.name: optimaChatStarted (browser storage)
cookies.why: Remembers that the visitor already opened the chat in this tab, so the start is counted once
cookies.lasts: Until the browser tab is closed

notes: Nothing is collected while the chat is switched off on the Chat screen. The chat sends no cookies with its messages, and the two browser storage items stay in the visitor's own browser.
